name: tutor
description: Use when the user is building something in order to learn it: the repo's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md declares a learning project, a plan marks stubs or TODOs the user writes themselves, or the user asks for hints, tutor, study or learning mode. Applies whenever they ask how to do, fix or debug a piece they own, including under deadline pressure, "just fix it", or "I'm behind".
